mission.title: The Apartment
mission.description: Follow Persephone to her meeting with Danielle Wright, then search the apartment Zion was combing for the interface program.

npc.say:
So...that is it. Yet she thinks nothing of the lives of those she claims to fight for.
I know what she feels she has lost, but that was nothing compared to what she is losing now.
That goes for you as well.

phase.briefing:
Persephone is insisting on seeing you, {player}. She tried "saving" that bluepill hosting the interface program again, after the Machines tracked it back down, and frankly, she's lucky to still be alive after the Machines again evinced their dislike for her interference.
By the way, if you haven't seen her since she first tried meddling with that bluepill's pod last week, get ready for a bit of a shock.

enter.say:
Unfortunately it didn't work out too well, either--Wright caught up to that bluepill while the Machines had her, and, well, pretty much straight up killed her, just to keep the Machines from having the interface program.
On the plus side, at least nobody else has been able to hold onto the interface program yet.

talk.say:
Wright... I know you can find her. I must speak to her.
Please.

done.say: She almost got killed by the Machines twice, and now she wants to hang out with Danielle Wright, termination-code-spammer extraordinaire? Oh, man.

phase.briefing:
She does want to get herself killed, doesn't she? Not that I care, only why does she have to try it on my watch? She could at least have a little consideration.
Of course, we have been following along with Wright's progress since she crushed the interface program's human host into the size of a softball in Westview. She's taken an interest in Richland again: Mannsdale, to be exact, although you couldn't find a worse--
What was that click? Still there, {player}? Then who-- Oh, damn it all. How did she access my work line? ... Well, you'd better get to Mannsdale, operative. It seems that Persephone's decided to go it alone.

enter.say: My readout's covered with override interference. You're probably in the right place.

talk.say: --all this killing? Their blood is on your hands. You can still stop this. If you don't...how many more will die because of you?

I'm fighting a war, program; I can't surrender simply because we take some losses. I've already lost more than you can possibly imagine.
This will end: when the Matrix is run by those who power it. Until that day comes, I will not stop. Don't try to interfere with me again.

phase.briefing:
... I wasn't worried, operative--after all, I could hardly be blamed for her rushing off like that--but you being the last person to have spoken to her, well, that would have looked bad, and I can't have you getting thrown into the iron maiden while I still have work I need you to finish.
In a way, Persephone's latest whirl in her dance with death has actually been useful: keeping Wright in conversation gave us a chance to take scans of the area. Zion has been busy; how they could have located it on their own, I've no idea, but the fact remains that they've homed in on a particular apartment in Eshean Projects, and I think we can all guess what they were looking for there.
No, the interface program, operative. They've cleared out now, but I expect you to get in there and figure out what they were up to.

enter.say: I'm reading an active computer system in there. Looks clear otherwise.

done.say:
What--?! Overrides! Great, that's blanked whatever was on that computer.
Too bad Persephone couldn't have kept her chatting longer. Maybe they could start a support group or something.
Sorry, but I didn't need you to see that.

phase.briefing: All my hard work, and you still let her beat you to it? You know, I'm a little insulted by that, {player}. I'll leave it to you to explain your latest failure to the Merovingian.

enter.say: Nothing like a pep talk from Flood to get you excited about meeting the boss...

talk.say:
Ah, it is you, {player}.
Yes... That is irritating... But not as provoking as what she--
Eh? Qu'est-ce que c'est?

done.say: How did this get here? Why do I pay for the best network security if something like this can happen?

"Wake up"? What is this "Wake up"? I am awake... I do not "awaken" like you humans from your pods.
Eh... The format looks like messages left in other places recently by the interface program... So, it is having a joke with me, hm? Ce n'est pas tres drole.

mission.finish:
It's just flashing pixels on a screen, operative. That's hardly going to solve this Wright problem.
Really, you people are so easily distracted...
